challenges.finding: Publisher reports no safe burial by the dedicated teams in Bas-Uele, with 4 community deaths reported but not handled that day, and no nutritional support for suspects in isolation there; 1 safe burial not carried out in Haut-Uele because of community resistance; 5 bodies not swabbed in Tshopo because of resistance or difficulties; a failed safe-burial attempt in Sud-Ubangi, where most health facilities lack waste sorting, water supply and adequate sanitation; in Nord-Ubangi a non-operational laboratory with 51 samples awaiting analysis, poor communication networks, too little communication credit for contact tracing and active case search, and shortages of basic goods; in Nord-Kivu a shortage of UHT milk for infants aged 6 to 23 months and 247 vaccine doses left of 3 600 received; and, with no province named, no guard shelters at secured sites, too little mobility and communication difficulties for security forces. No intervention effect is established.

Contact follow-up covers five reporting provinces. Sud-Ubangi prints ND and the Bas-Uele zero is withheld after the contact cohort moved between province labels in earlier editions. The lowest printed rate is Ituri (80.4%). No zero follow-up is inferred for any province.
